scope: PATH-01 batch configuration preview for 一键配置全部: per-tool read-only diffs, blocked tools excluded from the write set
status: implemented-and-isolated-ui-verified; real manager configuration write and real registry comparison not performed
implementation: pkgtools::preview_tool_configs evaluates every requested tool with the same single-tool checks and returns items plus explicit ready/blocked tool lists
ToolConfigRequest carries tool/globalPath/cachePath; every manager id is validated before any manager query runs
a tool with blocking reasons never contributes change rows; its changes are cleared and changedCount is 0 so batch totals cannot overstate pending work
a preview error for one tool is recorded as a blocked entry instead of aborting the whole batch
ToolConfigPreview gains changedCount, counting only rows whose value actually differs from the current value
the UI 一键配置全部 button now opens a read-only batch dialog listing per-tool changes, skipped tools and their reasons before any write
confirming writes only the tools listed in preview.ready, then reports written/skipped/failed counts separately

uiCoverage.previewBeforeWrite: 一键配置全部 calls preview_tool_configs and leaves the apply_tool_config count unchanged until 写入可用项 is pressed
uiCoverage.blockedToolSkipped: the pip fixture is blocked in the batch preview, is shown as 跳过 with its reason, and is never passed to apply_tool_config after confirmation
uiCoverage.diffSummary: per-tool 2 项变化 rows are asserted in the batch dialog

ui.command: node tests/run-ui.mjs <global playwright module> tests/settings-ui.mjs tests/startup-ui.mjs tests/release-052-ui.mjs tests/download-ui.mjs tests/package-manager-update-ui.mjs tests/scans-ui.mjs tests/scan-ui.mjs tests/sizes-ui.mjs tests/packages-ui.mjs

notVerified: No real package-manager configuration was changed; batch preview ran through fixtures and a simulated UI backend
The current-value side depends on each manager's own query commands and was not compared against real installations
limitations: The batch preview does not enumerate the concrete global packages that a reconfiguration would affect
Unchanged rows are still listed; the dialog labels counts but does not visually diff each row
A blocked tool is skipped silently beyond the dialog and toast summary; there is no per-tool retry action
